module origen_082813 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire reset,
    input wire FlushE,
    input wire [4:0] rsD, rtD, rdD,
    input wire [31:0] RD1, RD2,
    input wire [31:0] IR_D,
    input wire [31:0] im32_D,
    input wire [31:0] pc_8in,
    output reg [4:0] rsE, rtE, rdE,
    output reg [31:0] RD1_E, RD2_E,
    output reg [31:0] IR_E,
    output reg [31:0] im32_E,
    output reg [31:0] pc_8out
);

    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset || FlushE) begin
            rsE <= 5'b0;
            rtE <= 5'b0;
            rdE <= 5'b0;
            RD1_E <= 32'b0;
            RD2_E <= 32'b0;
            IR_E <= 32'b0;
            im32_E <= 32'b0;
            pc_8out <= 32'b0;
        end
        else begin
            rsE <= rsD;
            rtE <= rtD;
            rdE <= rdD;
            RD1_E <= RD1;
            RD2_E <= RD2;
            IR_E <= IR_D;
            im32_E <= im32_D;
            pc_8out <= pc_8in;
        end
    end

    initial begin
        rsE = 5'b0;
        rtE = 5'b0;
        rdE = 5'b0;
        RD1_E = 32'b0;
        RD2_E = 32'b0;
        IR_E = 32'b0;
        im32_E = 32'b0;
        pc_8out = 32'b0;
    end

endmodule
